verdict.rationale: Claude's own marketing lists "Hand off and schedule tasks," so a first-party scheduling capability exists, but nothing shows the schedules can recur rather than run once. There is also no documentation of how jobs or workflows are configured, and no hands-on corroboration. missing for 10: explicit recurring/cron-style scheduling, documentation of scheduled workflow configuration and management, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
